## ARRAY_CONCAT_AGG carries RANGE values, including inside STRUCTs.
# Source: third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/aggregate_functions.md:
# ARRAY_CONCAT_AGG concatenates ARRAYs, ignores NULL arrays, and supports ORDER BY and LIMIT.
# Compare individual elements to avoid depending on RANGE's output formatting.

WITH result AS (
  SELECT ARRAY_CONCAT_AGG(a ORDER BY n) AS a
  FROM (
    SELECT 2 AS n, [RANGE<DATE> '[2020-01-01, UNBOUNDED)'] AS a UNION ALL
    SELECT 1, [RANGE<DATE> '[UNBOUNDED, 2020-01-01)'] UNION ALL
    SELECT 3, CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<RANGE<DATE>>) UNION ALL
    SELECT 4, ARRAY<RANGE<DATE>>[]
  )
)
SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(a) = 2
  AND a[OFFSET(0)] = RANGE<DATE> '[UNBOUNDED, 2020-01-01)'
  AND a[OFFSET(1)] = RANGE<DATE> '[2020-01-01, UNBOUNDED)'
FROM result
=> "true"

WITH result AS (
  SELECT ARRAY_CONCAT_AGG(a ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1) AS a
  FROM (
    SELECT 1 AS n, [RANGE<DATETIME> '[UNBOUNDED, 2020-01-01 12:30:00)'] AS a UNION ALL
    SELECT 2, [RANGE<DATETIME> '[2020-01-01 12:30:00, UNBOUNDED)',
               RANGE<DATETIME> '[UNBOUNDED, UNBOUNDED)']
  )
)
SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(a) = 2
  AND a[OFFSET(0)] = RANGE<DATETIME> '[2020-01-01 12:30:00, UNBOUNDED)'
  AND a[OFFSET(1)] = RANGE<DATETIME> '[UNBOUNDED, UNBOUNDED)'
FROM result
=> "true"

WITH result AS (
  SELECT ARRAY_CONCAT_AGG(a ORDER BY n) AS a
  FROM (
    SELECT 2 AS n, [RANGE<TIMESTAMP> '[2020-01-01 00:00:00.5+00, UNBOUNDED)'] AS a UNION ALL
    SELECT 1, [RANGE<TIMESTAMP> '[UNBOUNDED, 2020-01-01 00:00:00.5+00)']
  )
)
SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(a) = 2
  AND a[OFFSET(0)] = RANGE<TIMESTAMP> '[UNBOUNDED, 2020-01-01 00:00:00.5+00)'
  AND a[OFFSET(1)] = RANGE<TIMESTAMP> '[2020-01-01 00:00:00.5+00, UNBOUNDED)'
FROM result
=> "true"

WITH result AS (
  SELECT ARRAY_CONCAT_AGG(a ORDER BY n) AS a
  FROM (
    SELECT 2 AS n, [STRUCT([2, 3] AS items, RANGE<DATE> '[2020-01-01, UNBOUNDED)' AS span)] AS a
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 1, [STRUCT([1] AS items, RANGE<DATE> '[UNBOUNDED, 2020-01-01)' AS span)]
  )
)
SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(a) = 2
  AND ARRAY_LENGTH(a[OFFSET(0)].items) = 1 AND a[OFFSET(0)].items[OFFSET(0)] = 1
  AND a[OFFSET(0)].span = RANGE<DATE> '[UNBOUNDED, 2020-01-01)'
  AND ARRAY_LENGTH(a[OFFSET(1)].items) = 2
  AND a[OFFSET(1)].items[OFFSET(0)] = 2 AND a[OFFSET(1)].items[OFFSET(1)] = 3
  AND a[OFFSET(1)].span = RANGE<DATE> '[2020-01-01, UNBOUNDED)'
FROM result
=> "true"

SELECT ARRAY_CONCAT_AGG(a) IS NULL
FROM (SELECT CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<RANGE<DATE>>) AS a)
=> "true"

SELECT ARRAY_CONCAT_AGG(a) IS NULL
FROM (SELECT [RANGE<DATE> '[UNBOUNDED, UNBOUNDED)'] AS a FROM UNNEST([1]) WHERE FALSE)
=> "true"

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(ARRAY_CONCAT_AGG(a))
FROM (SELECT ARRAY<RANGE<DATE>>[] AS a)
=> "0"

# NULL elements are preserved within the aggregate; inspect before returning the array.
SELECT a[OFFSET(0)] IS NULL AND a[OFFSET(1)] = RANGE<DATE> '[UNBOUNDED, UNBOUNDED)'
FROM (
  SELECT ARRAY_CONCAT_AGG(a ORDER BY n) AS a
  FROM (
    SELECT 1 AS n, [CAST(NULL AS RANGE<DATE>)] AS a UNION ALL
    SELECT 2, [RANGE<DATE> '[UNBOUNDED, UNBOUNDED)']
  )
)
=> "true"
